authorship: Original project draft; not copied from a dataset or publication.
review_rule: A fluent Lingala speaker must review all 50 lines. At least 40 must be approved as written or with correction, with at least 5 accepted lines in every domain, before the private baseline phase.

lines.text: Mbote, ozali malamu lelo?
lines.intent_en: Hello, are you well today?

lines.text: Nalingi komela mai ya malili, s’il vous plaît.
lines.intent_en: I would like to drink cold water, please.

lines.text: Telefoni na ngai ekufi mpo batri ezali lisusu te.
lines.intent_en: My phone died because the battery is empty.

lines.text: Nayoki malamu te; zongelá yango mpe lobá malɛmbɛ.
lines.intent_en: I did not understand well; repeat it and speak slowly.

lines.text: Mpo na nini oyei retare? Mituka etɛlɛmaki na nzela?
lines.intent_en: Why are you late? Was there traffic on the road?

lines.text: Zwá saki oyo ezali likoló ya kiti, tyá kati na yango biloko ya bana, mpe tiká yango pene na ekuke.
lines.intent_en: Take the bag on the chair, put the children's things inside it, and leave it near the door.

lines.text: Alobaki: “Zelá ngai awa—nakozonga noki!”
lines.intent_en: She said, 'Wait for me here—I will return quickly!'

lines.text: Bófongola mikanda na lokasa ya zomi.
lines.intent_en: Open your books to page ten.

lines.text: Soki obakisi mitano na nsambo, okozwa boni?
lines.intent_en: If you add five and seven, what do you get?

lines.text: Molakisi atindi liteya na ordinatɛrɛ ya kelasi.
lines.intent_en: The teacher sent the lesson to the school computer.

lines.text: Liloba oyo elobamaka ndenge moko te na Lingala mpe na Lifalanse.
lines.intent_en: This word is not pronounced the same way in Lingala and French.

lines.text: Liboso oloba liboso ya kelasi, bongisá makanisi na yo, lobá polele, mpe pesá ndakisa moko.
lines.intent_en: Before speaking to the class, organize your ideas, speak clearly, and give one example.

lines.text: Na maloba na yo moko, salá bokuse ya makambo misato ya ntina.
lines.intent_en: In your own words, summarize the three important points.

lines.text: Mokolo moko, mwana moko amonaki ndɛkɛ ya moke na nzela.
lines.intent_en: One day, a child saw a small bird on the road.

lines.text: “Kobanga te,” ndeko na ye alobaki, “nazali awa.”
lines.intent_en: 'Do not be afraid,' her sibling said, 'I am here.'

lines.text: Ntango moi ebimaki, engumba elamukaki na makelele ya mituka, bateki, mpe bana oyo bazalaki kokende kelasi.
lines.intent_en: When the sun rose, the city woke to the sounds of cars, vendors, and children going to school.

lines.text: “Ngai… nayebi te,” alobaki na mongongo ya nse.
lines.intent_en: 'I... do not know,' she said quietly.

lines.text: Nsolo ya mampa ya sika ekundwelaki ye ndako ya bomwana.
lines.intent_en: The smell of fresh bread reminded her of her childhood home.

lines.text: Uta mokolo wana, bazalaki lisusu kokutana pɔsɔ nyonso.
lines.intent_en: From that day on, they met every week.

lines.text: Finá 1 mpo na Lingala, to 2 mpo na Lifalanse.
lines.intent_en: Press 1 for Lingala or 2 for French.

lines.text: Mpo na kobatela kɔnti na yo, tosengeli kondimisa nkombo mpe dati ya mbotama.
lines.intent_en: To protect your account, we must confirm your name and date of birth.

lines.text: Fungolá liyebisi oyo totindeli yo mpo na kobongola mot de passe.
lines.intent_en: Open the message we sent you to change your password.

lines.text: Longolá aparɛyi na kura, zelá segɔnde tuku misato, mpe kangisá yango lisusu.
lines.intent_en: Unplug the device, wait thirty seconds, and connect it again.

lines.text: Likambo esalemaka ntango nyonso, to kaka ntango ofungoli programɛ?
lines.intent_en: Does the problem happen all the time or only when you open the application?

lines.text: Nsima ya lisolo oyo, pesá service na biso elembo kobanda 1 kino 5.
lines.intent_en: After this conversation, rate our service from 1 to 5.

lines.text: Sukolá maboko na sabuni mpe mai ya pɛto.
lines.intent_en: Wash your hands with soap and clean water.

lines.text: Soki mpema ezali kokata yo, luká lisalisi ya monganga noki.
lines.intent_en: If you have difficulty breathing, seek medical help quickly.

lines.text: Soki mwana azali na fiɛvrɛ, talá molunge na ye mpe benga monganga soki ezali komata.
lines.intent_en: If a child has a fever, monitor their temperature and call a clinician if it rises.

lines.text: Soki moto azangi mayele to azali kopema te, benga nimero ya lisungi ya lombangu mpe landá malako oyo bakopesa yo.
lines.intent_en: If someone is unconscious or not breathing, call the emergency number and follow the instructions given.

lines.text: Pasi ebandaki mokolo nini, mpe ezali kokóma makasi to kokita?
lines.intent_en: When did the pain begin, and is it getting stronger or weaker?

lines.text: Ondimi ete monganga atalá yo sikoyo?
lines.intent_en: Do you agree to be examined by the clinician now?

lines.text: Biloko nyonso efuti 15 750 FC.
lines.intent_en: All the items cost 15,750 Congolese francs.

lines.text: Rendez-vous na yo ezali mokolo ya 14 août 2026 na 09:30.
lines.intent_en: Your appointment is on 14 August 2026 at 09:30.
Call the Belgian telephone number plus thirty-two, two, five-five-five, zero-one, zero-nine.

lines.text: Molunge ya nzoto ezali 37,8 °C.
lines.intent_en: The body temperature is 37.8 degrees Celsius.

lines.text: Mobembo ekowumela ngonga 2 na miniti 20.
lines.intent_en: The journey will last two hours and twenty minutes.

lines.text: Afutaki 20 000 FC, mpe bazongiselaki ye 3 500 FC.
lines.intent_en: He paid 20,000 Congolese francs and received 3,500 francs in change.

lines.text: Réservation ya 21/12 ezali na 19:15 mpe efuti 45 €.
lines.intent_en: The reservation for 21 December is at 19:15 and costs 45 euros.

lines.text: Chantal Mbuyi akoyamba bino na ekuke.
lines.intent_en: Chantal Mbuyi will welcome you at the entrance.

lines.text: François Noël akomaki liboso ya midi.
lines.intent_en: François Noël arrived before noon.

lines.text: Dr Mukendi akomona yo na nsima ya nzanga.
lines.intent_en: Doctor Mukendi will see you in the afternoon.

lines.text: Pakɛ ekokende na avenue Kasa-Vubu 120, Kinshasa.
lines.intent_en: The parcel will go to 120 Avenue Kasa-Vubu, Kinshasa.

lines.text: Tindá mokanda na rue de la Loi 16, Bruxelles.
lines.intent_en: Send the letter to 16 Rue de la Loi, Brussels.

lines.text: Masuwa ezali kokende uta Matadi kino Boma.
lines.intent_en: The boat is traveling from Matadi to Boma.

lines.text: Nasengi yo otindela ngai facture na e-mail.
lines.intent_en: Please send me the invoice by email.

lines.text: Nalingi kozwa rendez-vous mpo na lobi.
lines.intent_en: I would like an appointment for tomorrow.

lines.text: Connexion ezali instable; meká koboma mpe kozongisa Wi-Fi.
lines.intent_en: The connection is unstable; try turning Wi-Fi off and on again.

lines.text: Pourquoi otindaki message sans expliquer problème?
lines.intent_en: Why did you send a message without explaining the problem?

lines.text: Fungolá Bluetooth mpo casque ekangama na telefone.
lines.intent_en: Turn on Bluetooth so the headset can connect to the phone.

lines.text: Na réunion ya lobi, tokotala budget, calendrier ya lancement, mpe feedback oyo ba clients batindaki.
lines.intent_en: At tomorrow's meeting, we will review the budget, launch schedule, and feedback sent by customers.

selection_rule: Deterministic 50-line prototype subset: all eight domains, 9 easy, 21 medium, and 20 hard lines, prioritizing contemporary speech and high-risk TTS features.
